# `corelink doctor`

Run the 8 canonical diagnostic checks. Every non-`ok` check carries a
`next_action_doc` URL pointing at the right fix in the error taxonomy.

## Synopsis

```bash
corelink doctor [--json] [--output <FORMAT>]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | no | — | Shorthand for `--output=json`. |
| `--output` | no | `text` | `text` or `json`. |

## The 8 checks

| # | Check | What it validates |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `network`         | DNS + TCP + TLS handshake to the CoreLink API. |
| 2 | `auth`            | PAT resolves, scopes are non-empty, tenant matches. |
| 3 | `storage_write`   | 1 KB synthetic blob round-trip write. |
| 4 | `storage_read`    | Read-back of the synthetic blob. |
| 5 | `byok`            | BYOK key reachable (skipped if BYOK disabled). |
| 6 | `region`          | Tenant home region matches resolved endpoint. |
| 7 | `quota`           | Storage and bandwidth headroom > 10%. |
| 8 | `client_verify`   | BLAKE3 WASM/native verifier loads + matches root. |

## Examples

```bash
corelink doctor
```

```text
✔ network          OK
✔ auth             OK (scopes: cas:read, cas:write)
✔ storage_write    OK (12ms)
✔ storage_read     OK (8ms)
○ byok             SKIP (disabled for tenant)
✔ region           OK (iad1)
⚠ quota            WARN — 92% storage used  →  docs/reference/error-taxonomy#COR_QUOTA_001
✔ client_verify    OK
```

JSON:

```bash
corelink doctor --json
```

## JSON schema

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "subcommand": "doctor",
  "checks": [
    {
      "name": "quota",
      "status": "warn",
      "message": "92% storage used",
      "next_action_doc": "docs/reference/error-taxonomy#COR_QUOTA_001"
    }
  ]
}
```

`status` is one of `ok | warn | fail | skip`. The top-level `ok` is `false`
if any check is `fail`; `warn` does not flip the overall flag.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | All checks `ok` (or `warn` only). |
| `1` | One or more checks `fail`. |
| `2` | Argument error. |
